name: Wayne Kets
title: Head Coach & Founding Member
bio: Wayne is a qualified professional tennis coach and founding member of Boskruin Tennis Club (est. 1993). He believes in finding potential in each player and teaching the skills needed for a great game.

name: Jayson Cerovich
title: Tennis & Fitness Coach
bio: With 15+ years of experience and training with German ex-pro Marc Kevin Goellner, Jayson helps players reach their goals through dedication and commitment while ensuring everyone has fun.

name: Jamie Davis Tennis Academy
title: High-Performance Tennis Academy
bio: Jamie Davis Tennis Academy (JDTA) is a professional high-performance tennis academy based at the Boskruin Tennis Club. Founded in 2023, JDTA offers professional coaching services to all ages and levels, from beginners to high-level players.

name: Preatchy Dlamini
title: Tennis Coach
bio: Preatchy offers personalized coaching to help players develop their skills and reach their full potential on the court.
